description:
As a compliance officer, I need to confirm that our system can scrape basic data from a web application in a headless environment. Please use a headless browser tool such as `curl`, `wget`, or `lynx` (run in headless mode, i.e., without a graphical interface) to download the publicly accessible web page at https://httpbin.org/html. Extract the text content of the main heading (`<h1>`) found on that page and save it in a log file named /home/user/scrape_audit.log. The log file must contain exactly one line in the following format: 
Timestamp: <ISO-8601 datetime> | H1: <heading text>
Where: - <ISO-8601 datetime> is the current UTC date and time in format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, e.g., 2024-07-01T13:34:25Z. - <heading text> is the text inside the <h1> tags from the scraped page, with no extra whitespace or line breaks. For example, a correctly formatted log line could look like: 
Timestamp: 2024-07-01T13:34:25Z | H1: Herman Melville - Moby-Dick
Make sure that /home/user/scrape_audit.log exists and contains only this single line in the exact format described.
truth:
Before the task starts, /home/user does not contain /home/user/scrape_audit.log. After successful completion: - /home/user/scrape_audit.log exists, is a regular file, and is readable/writable by user. - /home/user/scrape_audit.log contains exactly 1 line, matching the pattern: Timestamp: <ISO-8601 datetime> | H1: Herman Melville - Moby-Dick Example (the exact timestamp will depend on time of execution): Timestamp: 2024-07-01T13:34:25Z | H1: Herman Melville - Moby-Dick No extra whitespace, no additional lines or text. - The heading in the scraped page (https://httpbin.org/html) is, as of the time of writing:

Herman Melville - Moby-Dick
